title: Agent report schild.agent_report/0.1 (v0.3, MVP-11)
description: Payload of the DSSE envelope an agent sends to the gateway schild (payloadType application/vnd.schild.agent-report.v0+json, exactly one signature by the agent's own key, purpose agent). Binds the host report to one gateway, a time and a nonce (replay window 5 min / 120 s skew). See host-check.md section 3.

gateway.description: node_name of the gateway the agent is enrolled at.

nonce.description: 16 random bytes, lower-case hex; new for every delivery attempt.
